summary_out.changed: Replaced ptg-isl-g1l1's BINARY spread-p75 hard-cut with a PROBABILISTIC submit-decay across the [p50, p75] band: spread <= p50 admits at p=1.0 (full size), p50 < spread <= p75 admits at p in [0.05, 1.0] decaying linearly with rank-in-band, spread > p75 hard-skip (g3l2 confirmed [p75, p80] EV-negative; not relaxed). Per-order draw is deterministic SHA-256 of client_order_id. Single-knob discipline: only the gate semantics changed (binary -> probabilistic); spread_window_seconds=60, min_samples=50, position_cap=1, q_upper=0.75 all unchanged from g1l1. Decision triggered by gen-3 migration base_specific(1) directive to switch from skip-axis stacking to quantity-modulation on this base.
summary_out.outcome: pnl 5571.25 (+30.70% vs base position-tier-gate 4262.50 - BEATS BASE AND BREAKS THE TWO-AXIS SATURATION CEILING that pinned the island-0 lineage since g1l1); +3.28% vs g1l1 lineage best (5394.25); +5.35% vs g3l2 prior (5288.50). sharpe 25.112 (g1l1 23.168, +1.94; base 17.619). trade_count 86377 (-1.08% vs g1l1 87319, -942 trades) - consistent with construction (decay only REDUCES admission within [p50, p75]; upper hard-cut unchanged); inside the 10% falsification budget. max_drawdown -0.54% (g1l1 -0.61%; tighter, indicating the decay preferentially removes the high-cost edge of the admitted population). win_rate 0.3813 (g1l1 0.3806, ~flat). mean_slippage 0.0; is_weighted_bps 0.0258 (g1l1 0.0285, -9.5%).
summary_out.hypothesis: CONFIRMED. Pre-declared falsification class 'Lifts to >+28.5% vs base' is triggered (+30.70%). The EV-vs-spread-rank curve inside [p50, p75] is not flat - adverse-selection cost grows monotonically enough with rank that shifting expected exposure away from the high-rank edge of the band lifts realized pnl above g1l1's uniform admission. The saturation ceiling that held the island-0 lineage flat from g1l1 through g3l2 (g3l2 plateau within +/-2% of g1l1) was an artifact of the binary-cut MECHANISM CLASS, not the base algo's expressive limit. Quantity-modulation / probabilistic admission shape is a fresh productive mechanism class on ptg, validated as a cross-island insight transfer (vrs-isl-g1l1's chop-decay pattern adapted to ptg's spread-rank distribution).
summary_out.next: Retune the probabilistic-decay SHAPE now that the mechanism is confirmed live. Ranked: (1) Decay shape: linear -> exponential (exp(-sensitivity * excess_rank)). vrs uses exponential and produced +34% vs its base; if the EV-vs-rank curve is convex (cost rising faster than linearly) the exponential will front-load admission probability into the cheap end of the band and lift further. (2) Band placement: [p50, p75] -> [p60, p80] or [p40, p75] - current p_lower=p50 was a conservative anchor; pushing p_lower up concentrates the decay into the actually-expensive part of the spread distribution while preserving full admission below the median. (3) min_prob floor 0.05 sweep (0.0 hard upper edge, 0.10 gentler floor) - smallest free-parameter retune, reserve for g4l2 only if (1) or (2) are inconclusive. Pick option (1) for g4l2 to keep the single-knob discipline: change shape while holding band + min_prob fixed, so the lift vs g4l1 is mechanism-attributable.
